rows.grounds: Compound mat (my) + sannidhau (presence, proximity); locative sense of nearness.
Sandhi of bhavān (honorable you) + ebhyaḥ (to these, to them); address plus recipient.
Imperative of kath (to tell, to relate); command to speak.
Sandhi of sva-guruḥ (one's own guru) + bhavān (honorable you); identifies the addressee as their own guru.
